title: Podcast: El talks crypto and blockchain with agent friend Wen Xiong
author: El Lee
description: Both El and Wen Xiong are brokers at One Global Property Services (OGPS). Today, Wen Xiong invites El to release a podcast, talking about one possible areas of diversification for real estate investors, into crypto. Before one can make a choice, he/she needs to first gain sufficient understanding of the investment subject. El operates a crypto custody firm outside of his work at OGPS. His firm Onchain Custodian is a Singapore based digital asset custody firm. They also provide open finance services such as lending and asset management.
